payload.body: Reality check (2026-06-07): in_progress but no branch and no activity since 2026-06-01. This story ("Port *Store implementations to the storage driver") was superseded by the FR-118–122 slice breakdown (FR-23a–e) under FR-4; the actual in-flight work is FR-118. FR-23 itself is not independently being worked. Consider closing/cancelling it in favor of the FR-118–122 slices, or keep it as the tracking umbrella — owner's call.
